review_candidates.title: Scheduler
review_candidates.description: Are you ambitious and looking to make the right move in your career? Now is the perfect time to join Egis. We are now over 21,000 engineers, architects, scientists and planners across the world and experiencing substantial growth in North America. This strategic move underscores our commitment to investing in North America, propelling our expansion to new heights. Job Description The Scheduler supports the development, maintenance, and analysis of project schedules for complex capital projects in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Working closely with project management, engineering, construction, and project controls teams, the role helps establish schedule baselines, monitor project progress, identify potential delays, and provide accurate scheduling information to support successful project delivery. The position requires practical experience in project scheduling, Primavera P6, critical path analysis, progress measurement, forecasting, and project controls. Working within a multidisciplinary project environment, the Scheduler supports the integration of scope, schedule, and project milestones while contributing to schedule reporting, risk identification, change management, and performance monitoring. The ideal candidate has experience supporting major capital, engineering, construction, infrastructure, industrial, or energy projects and demonstrates strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate schedule information across multiple project stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. Support the establishment and maintenance of schedule baselines, milestones, activities, dependencies, and project calendars. Coordinate with project managers, engineering teams, construction teams, and other stakeholders to collect schedule inputs and validate project progress. Perform critical path analysis and monitor critical and near-critical activities that may affect project delivery. Monitor actual progress against approved schedules and identify schedule variances, delays, constraints, and emerging risks. Prepare regular schedule updates, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, progress reports, and schedule forecasts. Support progress measurement and Earned Value Management (EVM) activities, including analysis of schedule performance indicators where applicable. Assist with schedule forecasting and evaluate potential impacts to project completion dates and key milestones. Support the assessment of project changes and incorporate approved scope and schedule changes into project schedules. Maintain schedule logic, activity relationships, calendars, coding structures, and other scheduling data to ensure schedule quality and integrity. Participate in project meetings and provide scheduling information to support project planning, coordination, and decision-making. Assist with schedule risk identification and the development of mitigation or recovery strategies for potential delays. Prepare project controls reports and dashboards covering schedule performance, milestone status, progress, and forecast completion dates. Support continuous improvement of scheduling processes, project controls procedures, reporting, and schedule management practices. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of project scheduling or project controls experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, industrial, energy, manufacturing, or other major capital project environments. Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, and updating detailed project schedules. Proficiency with Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. Experience with critical path method (CPM) scheduling, schedule logic, dependencies, milestones, and baseline management. Experience with progress measurement, schedule forecasting, variance analysis, and project performance reporting. Understanding of project controls principles and the relationship between scope, schedule, cost, and project performance. Ability to analyze schedule information, identify potential delays or constraints, and communicate findings clearly to project stakeholders. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams and manage scheduling information across multiple workstreams. Assets Experience applying Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and interpreting schedule performance indicators such as SPI. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP) certification or progress toward certification. Experience supporting large-scale capital or infrastructure projects. Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering and construction environments. Exposure to schedule risk analysis, change management, and recovery scheduling. Experience with project controls dashboards, reporting tools, or advanced project performance analytics. Additional Information Egis Canada is an equal opportunities employer offering a competitive salary and benefits to those with the skills suited to the needs of our clients. The salary range advertised may exceed the range based on several factors, including relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. This role is eligible for a referral bonus in line with the Referral Program. If you have been referred, please provide the name of the employee who has referred you at the time of your application. At Egis, we embrace innovation to tackle challenges and utilize AI in our recruitment process under stringent ethics and compliance policies and in alignment with our values of being a Responsible Company, a People First Company and a Creative Company. Committed to diversity, growth and collaboration, we may leverage AI to support the recruitment process.

review_candidates.title: Engineer Fiber – Harderwijk
review_candidates.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen de afdeling Fiber-glaszakelijke markt ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en engineeren van hoogwaardige glasvezelverbindingen. In deze rol ben je geen tekenaar, maar een technisch expert die de regie pakt over het hele voortraject. Je analyseert de klantvraag, vertaalt deze naar een technisch haalbaar ontwerp en bewaakt de kwaliteitsstandaarden die bij de zakelijke markt horen. Jouw focus ligt op: Technisch Ontwerp & Regie: Je ontwerpt complexe glasvezelnetwerken en zorgt dat deze voldoen aan alle technische specificaties en wetgeving. Haalbaarheidstoetsing: Je kijkt kritisch naar de situatie buiten. Is wat we op papier bedenken ook echt te realiseren? Je voorkomt verrassingen tijdens de bouw. Vraagbaak voor Uitvoering: Je bent het technische aanspreekpunt voor projectleiders en uitvoerders. Met jouw advies zorg je dat zij hun werk efficiënt kunnen doen. Procesbewaking: Je zorgt voor een vlekkeloze administratieve afhandeling en revisie, zodat onze netwerkdocumentatie altijd up-to-date is. Wie zijn wij? Allinq verbindt mensen. Met ruim 60 jaar aan kennis en ervaring ontwerpen, realiseren, beheren en onderhouden wij informatie-infrastructuren voor netwerkeigenaren in de telecomwereld en daarbuiten. Denk aan traditionele kabelnetwerken waaronder glasvezel, moderne ICT-voorzieningen en draadloze verbindingen. Net zo gemakkelijk onder de grond als inpandig in grote gebouwen. Dit doen wij vanuit meerdere organisatieonderdelen in binnen- en buitenland, met bijna 800 eigen vakmensen en een grote flexibele schil. We hebben gerenommeerde opdrachtgevers, zoals bijvoorbeeld KPN, Odido, VodafoneZiggo, en Glaspoort. Allinq onderscheidt zich nadrukkelijk door het zijn van een betrouwbare en innovatieve business partner, een kwaliteitsonderneming. Wij staan voor smart en effectief samenwerken in de keten en voor duurzame relaties met opdrachtgevers. Allinq is onderdeel van de Allinq Group en heeft haar hoofdkantoor in Nederland. Er werken circa 2.000 medewerkers voor de Allinq Group. Allinq is internationaal actief en heeft ook vestigingen in Duitsland, Denemarken en Tsjechië Wat breng je mee? Je hebt passie voor netwerkoplossingen en beschikt over een proactieve, aanpakgerichte mentaliteit. Door middel van jouw nieuwsgierigheid en enthousiasme inspireer je collega’s en draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van het team. Samen werken jullie aan steeds betere resultaten voor onze klanten. Je hebt affiniteit met glasvezelnetwerken en bent bekent met de branche. Je hebt ervaring in een soortgelijke rol als engineer. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal en heb goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Je hebt een afgeronde MBO opleiding met voorkeur in een technische richting. Wat bieden wij? Een werkgever waar je op kunt bouwen! Onze medewerkers bepalen het succes van Allinq. Samen moeten we de klus klaren, onze manier van werken is daarom heel bepalend. We hebben een bijzondere cultuur waarin we je kansen bieden om te blijven groeien. Uitdaging om continue in beweging te blijven. Fijne collega's die je graag verder helpen. En een werkklimaat waarin we je stimuleren om met verbeterideeën te komen! Verder krijg je: Een salaris tussen de € 3.391 en € 3.889 , gebaseerd op 38 uur, volgens de CAO Kleinmetaal en Techniek . 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen, bij een fulltime dienstverband. 8% vakantiegeld. Een auto passend bij jouw functie/ Een reiskostvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer. Een telefoon en laptop van de zaak. De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, met een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,45 per dag. Een goede pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds PMT. Allinq kan onder voorwaarden kinderen van medewerkers voordragen voor een bijdrage in de studiekosten via de onafhankelijke stichting Educatie4All. Waarom zou je bij ons willen werken? Volop kansen om te blijven groeien in je vak; uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden Afwisselend werk dat ertoe doet in een dynamische sfeer Fijne collega’s die je graag verder helpen Een werkklimaat waarin we je stimuleren om met verbeterideeën te komen

review_candidates.description: HumeLink West Project Two CIMIC Group companies, UGL and CPB Contractors have been selected by Transgrid to deliver the 130km western section of the HumeLink high voltage electricity transmission project. HumeLink is a new 500kV transmission project which will connect Wagga Wagga, Maragle and Bannaby in regional NSW that will significantly increase the capacity of the electricity network in Australia’s eastern states. HumeLink is one of Australia’s largest energy infrastructure projects, with about 365kms of proposed new transmission lines and a range of other new and upgraded infrastructure. The HumeLink West scope of works, worth $1.4bn, includes delivery of new 500kV double circuit transmission lines spanning ~140kms from Wagga Wagga Substation to a new Substation at Gugaa, the Interface Point with HumeLink East near Gundagai and a new substation at Maragle in the Snowy Mountains for future connection to Snowy 2.0. Key Accountabilities We are seeking an experienced Cost Controller to join the HumeLink West team. The position is responsible for: Provide strong focus on cost trending and forecasting Establish and monitor project baseline budgets Produce regular end of month cost reports Maintain risk registers to include change impacts Monitor and report on cost actuals vs budget, Liaison with the PCM for compiling and submitting client progress claims The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered. What are we looking for you to bring to the team: Tertiary qualifications in business, commercial, engineering, finance or similar preferred Minimum 5 years practical experience on major infrastructure projects Demonstrated experience with cost management tools (excel, SAP, Power Bi, sharepoint, JDE) Highly developed communication, negotiation and influencing skills Strong conflict resolution skills, coupled with the ability to work independently in a fast paced construction environment The successful candidate will be required to hold a current Construction Industry Induction Card (White Card or equivalent) and undergo a medical assessment (including drug and alcohol testing) prior to commencement. Where applicable, evidence of tertiary qualifications and proof of right to work will be required prior to successful appointment. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We support women in construction, Indigenous advancement and participation and encourage people of all cultural backgrounds to apply. We’re always looking for ways to make UGL and CPB Contractors a more rewarding place to work and offer a unique set of benefits, including: A rewarding career where we support your development, training and promote from within. Opportunities across all construction sectors so that there is always an opportunity suitable for the next stage in your career. Competitive remuneration and excellent benefits including a health and wellbeing program, discount portal and company-funded salary continuance insurance. Flexible work arrangements and a culture that values diversity and innovation. Please note: This role is being sourced through UGL and CPB Contractors directly and we will not accept applications via external recruitment agencies.
